description: Wrong logical operator: uses OR instead of AND for the newline check, causing standalone newlines or any character after a carriage return to misbehave.
Wrong comparison character: checks against '\r' instead of '\n' in the second condition.
Wrong variable used for tracking the previous character: updates lastChar with current before the conditional check instead of after.
Swapped return value: returns 'current' instead of 'lastChar' at the end of the method.
Missing assignment to lastChar: forgets to record the current character into lastChar, breaking subsequent newline tracking after carriage returns.
